issues.element: The page subtitle now fits on one line, so the toolbar card moved up to y≈72. The 52px-tall header utility box (refresh / globe / logout, y≈24–75) now overlaps the toolbar card's top-right corner by about 3px and sticks out about 25px past the card's right edge. The two bordered boxes touch and cross. Same on tokens-1366 and tokens-1280, and on every screen at these sizes.
issues.fix: Reserve the header box's height in the title row: give the title row a min-height equal to the utility group's height plus an 8px gap, or align the utility group's bottom with the title baseline. It must never cross into the toolbar card. Better still, shrink the utility group to toolbar control height (about 30px) so it fits inside the title row.

issues.element: The header utility group (refresh / globe / logout) is still a 52px heavily rounded bordered pod. It matches no toolbar control's height, radius or border, and its refresh icon duplicates the toolbar Refresh button. At 390 in the loading state its refresh icon shows a lifted/pressed surface while the toolbar Refresh is disabled, so the two refresh controls show conflicting states.
issues.fix: Use toolbar control height and radius for the header icons, about 30px, with the same 6px radius as the toolbar pills. Either hide the header refresh on Analytics or make both refresh controls share one disabled/busy state.

issues.element: 'Apply' (search row) still has the same lifted fill and white bold label as Refresh while the search box is empty. It looks fully actionable when there is nothing to apply. 'Clear filters' now dims correctly at defaults, which shows that the disabled treatment exists but isn't applied to Apply.
issues.fix: Render Apply with the same disabled treatment as the default-state Clear filters (grey label) until the input differs from the applied value.

issues.element: Unchanged from r12: the 3-column view grid wraps 'Tokens & Cache' and 'Model Rates' onto 2 lines. In expanded filters (expanded/tokens-320), the selected 'Last 24 hours' and 'Last 30 days' also wrap, so cell heights are uneven and the selected pill becomes a 2-line block.
issues.fix: Below about 360px, use a 2-column grid for the view and time-range segmented groups, or use nowrap with reduced horizontal padding

issues.element: The 'View data table', 'Coverage limitations', 'Measurement details' and 'Rate details' disclosures are still 11–12px text with roughly 16–20px tall hit areas, below the 24px WCAG 2.5.8 minimum. On phones they are the only route to the tabular data. Applies to tokens, cost, performance, unknown and rates as well.
issues.fix: Give the summary elements min-height 24px under pointer:fine and 44px under pointer:coarse through padding, with the caret inside the hit area

issues.element: Every chart footnote at 390 still says 'Hover or focus a time to compare values; activate it to open matching events.' On touch there is no hover. Same on overview, tokens, performance and unknown at 390.
issues.fix: Under pointer:coarse, say 'Tap a time to compare values; tap again to open matching events.'

issues.element: The search input is narrowed to about 210px, so the placeholder clips mid-word ('Model or request referenc').
issues.fix: At this width give search its own full-width row above the three selects (as on phones), or shorten the placeholder to 'Model or request ID'

issues.element: 'Clear filters' and 'Refresh' now stay together (good), but they occupy a whole extra toolbar row with empty space to their left. That pushes the Usage trend footnotes and 'View data table' below the fold.
issues.fix: Move the Clear filters / Refresh cluster to the end of the search+selects row at this width, or put it beside the bucket group when the time-range row wraps

issues.element: Same header utility box / toolbar card collision as the overview at these sizes
issues.fix: Same fix as the overview: reserve the utility group's height in the title row or shrink it to control height

issues.element: Selected 'Tokens & Cache' view pill and 'Last 24 hours' time pill wrap to 2 lines (expanded/tokens-320)
issues.fix: 2-column segmented grids below 360px, or nowrap labels

issues.element: The 'Reference: current configured model rates…' note box ends around x≈1910, while the Model Rates card and toolbar extend to about 2240. Its right edge is the only one on the page that doesn't line up.
issues.fix: Make the note span the full content width like the cost and performance notes (width:100%, no max-width), or put it inside the Model Rates card header

issues.element: The note says these are current configured rates, not historical ones. Yet the time-range pills, bucket pills (Auto/Hourly/Daily), outcomes select and search all look fully enabled on this view, and changing them can't affect the table.
issues.fix: On Model Rates, disable (dim plus aria-disabled) the time-range, bucket and outcome controls, or hide them and show a one-line 'Time range does not apply to current rates' note. Keep only the provider and model filters active.

issues.element: The 'Rate details' disclosure in each stacked card is a small right-aligned text link of about 20px height, the only way into tier schedules
issues.fix: Make it a full-width 44px-tall row under pointer:coarse

issues.element: Row 'Details' buttons are outlined (border, transparent fill). Every other secondary action (Refresh, Apply, Previous, Next) uses the lifted grey fill with no border. Two secondary-button styles appear on one screen.
issues.fix: Render Details with the same lifted-fill secondary style and height as Refresh and Next, or make all secondary buttons outlined. Pick one.

issues.element: '128 retained events' sits about 6px lower than the 'Requests' card title, so the two don't share a baseline
issues.fix: Align the count to the title baseline with align-items: baseline in the card header

issues.element: The empty-state card says 'Choose a longer range to look further back' but offers no control. The error state does provide a Retry button. The header also still shows 'Partial coverage' and a 'Coverage limitations' disclosure when nothing was retained.
issues.fix: Add a secondary button in the empty card, e.g. 'Show last 7 days', that selects the next longer range. Hide or reword the partial-coverage chip when the range has no events.

issues.element: Both empty charts still offer a 'View data table' disclosure even though they say 'No measured values in this interval.' The affordance leads to an empty table.
issues.fix: Hide the data-table disclosure when a series has no measured values, or label it 'View data table (no measured values)'

issues.element: In the error state only, the toolbar Refresh button gains a visible light border (outlined), which it doesn't have on any other screen. The error card's 'Retry' is the page's only white filled button, though it does exactly what Refresh does. The result is two differently styled buttons for one action.
issues.fix: Keep Refresh in its normal style during errors. Make Retry the single emphasised action, and either temporarily disable the toolbar Refresh or have both share one style.

issues.element: Loading is still a single 'Loading analytics…' text strip. No KPI or chart skeletons reserve space, so the page jumps from about 60px of content to the full dashboard when data arrives.
issues.fix: Render the KPI grid and the first chart card as skeleton blocks at their final sizes, with the 'Loading analytics…' text in an aria-live status

issues.element: While loading, Refresh is correctly disabled, but 'Apply', the time/bucket pills and the selects all look fully enabled. At 390 the header refresh icon shows a lit/pressed surface.
issues.fix: During load, show Apply in the disabled treatment and give the header refresh the same disabled/busy state as the toolbar Refresh. Optionally add a spinner to the Refresh icon.

issues.element: The content area collapses to one 64px strip, leaving about 600px of empty canvas under the toolbar
issues.fix: Skeleton layout as above

regressions: overview/tokens (and every screen) at 1366x768 and 1280x720: the subtitle now fits on one line (the 'Retained usage events' label is gone), so the toolbar card moved up and its top-right corner now touches or overlaps the 52px header utility box. In r12 the two-line subtitle kept them separated.

No other screen got worse. Improvements: the orphaned Refresh at 1366 is fixed (the whole Token trend now fits above the fold), Clear filters is visibly disabled at defaults, Apply is no longer a white primary button, and 'Flat trend' no longer wraps in the Failed events tile at 390/1024.
reference_gaps: The reference puts the view tabs in their own bordered container above a separate controls panel. Prox nests the view tabs inside the same toolbar card as time range and filters, so the views read as one more filter rather than page-level navigation.
The reference search is a full-width row of its own with live filtering (no Apply). Prox shares the row with an 'Apply' button and three selects, which makes the search field narrow at 768–1440.

Reference filter dropdowns are custom-styled controls matching the pills' height, radius and fill. Prox uses native <select> elements with OS chevrons and a darker fill than the pills, so they visibly belong to a different control family.

The reference's right-hand cluster is 'Current bucket' caption · Clear all · Show advanced filters · auto-refresh countdown · Refresh. Prox lacks the auto-refresh indicator and an advanced-filters toggle, and drops the bucket caption at 1366 and below.

The reference time-range group includes 'Custom'. Prox has no custom-range entry point, and its bucket group omits finer buckets (1 min, 15 min) shown disabled-when-inapplicable in the reference. The reference shows disabled segments in place, which Prox could adopt for rates-view controls too.
